name: apprenti.dev Software Engineering Apprenticeship
audience: University student complementing a Mathematics/Computer Science degree
philosophy: Evidence-driven apprenticeship: learn, build, prove, reflect, review.
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used.
Tasks may restrict solution generation while allowing explanations, hints, quizzes and review.
The apprentice remains accountable for every submitted artifact.
Mentor approval is based on demonstrated understanding, not AI output quality.
